description: Historische Wasserleitungen Wien is a dataset listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by data.wien.gv.at. Course of selected historical water pipes from the 18th and 19th centuries. Coverage: AT. The portal shows the English title as "Historical water pipes Vienna" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Wasserversorgung, Historisches, Wasser, Wasserleitung, Geschichte, ViennaGIS. The listing shows 6 download or service links in WMS, JPEG, PNG, GML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
